svg.title: Add the contributions from the shared w1
svg.desc: The w1 gradient is A's contribution 1×2×1×2=4 plus B's 0.5×2×1×1=1, giving 5. The prediction gradients already include the batch-mean factor 1/2.

g.data-text: Add the contributions from the shared w1
g.aria-label: Add the contributions from the shared w1

g.data-text: Backward order: begin at the loss and move to earlier values.
g.aria-label: Backward order: begin at the loss and move to earlier values.

g.data-text: Contribution to the w1 gradient of mean loss: 4
g.aria-label: Contribution to the w1 gradient of mean loss: 4

g.data-text: Contribution to the w1 gradient of mean loss: 1
g.aria-label: Contribution to the w1 gradient of mean loss: 1

g.data-text: The factor ÷2 is already included in 1 and 0.5.
g.aria-label: The factor ÷2 is already included in 1 and 0.5.

g.data-text: Do not divide the total 5 by 2 again.
g.aria-label: Do not divide the total 5 by 2 again.
